name: sec-patching-ts
description: Ships a production security hotfix for vulnerable npm dependencies in a TypeScript or Node.js repository, on a trust-but-verify basis with proportional risk handling. It trusts the package manager to resolve a patched version, then verifies that the advisory is real and reaches production, that the new version is the genuine upstream fix with no malicious code, and that nothing breaks for this application. It weighs each risk (CVSS attack complexity, user interaction, C/I/A impact, EPSS, exposure in this code) against the cost of the fix, and records accepted risks in the project's Trivy or Dependabot ignores. It branches from the commit running in production, compares the project's gates with a baseline, runs /code-review high --fix, opens the PR and babysits CI. --automerge merges once green; --release also ships. Use when the user asks to patch or remediate vulnerable dependencies, CVEs, GHSA advisories, npm/pnpm/yarn/bun audit findings or Dependabot alerts.
